Subject: High latency & 500s since modelpack v5 / int8 swap

Attached a small sample of logs and a couple of traces (we redacted PII). Can you confirm if this is related to the new quant profile or something else? We need an ETA — this is customer-impacting.

I see the traces, thank you. We've started an internal P0 channel. Initial signal: increased KV cache miss amplification after the int8 qprofile was enabled for the v5 runtime; some kernels are falling back to slower paths which inflates tail latency and in rare paths triggers OOMs -> 500s.

Plan for the next 60 minutes:
- Rishi will validate runtime kernel fallbacks and hotpatch metrics.
- Irene will verify quantization table selection and sequence-length heuristics.
- I'll coordinate rollback to the prior qprofile if we confirm correlation.

Marissa — can you please notify the CE success contact and arrange a short customer status call at 2pm PST?

We will update in the P0 channel and share the ops logs. Apologies for the breakage — prioritizing rollback/fix.

David

Subject: Re: High latency & 500s since modelpack v5 / int8 swap

Quick updates from infra:
- Observed kernel fallback events on g4-rtd nodes serving Cascade traffic starting at 08:45Z. The int8 path triggered an alternate GEMM kernel due to a mis-selected block-size for seq_len > 512.
- Memory pressure spikes correspond to the fallback windows; two instances reported OOMs and restarted (hence 500s).
- Throughput per-GPU dropped ~28% during fallback windows.

Recommendation: rollback the qprofile to v4-int16 for Cascade's routing pool and disable the automatic int8 rollout for modelpack v5 until we ship a kernel patch (ETA 48 hours). Rollback is low-risk and reversible.

I've opened RI ticket RI-9241 and attached node logs to the Jira. Markus — flagging for possible exec notification given revenue exposure.

Rishi
Head of Infra Engineering
